purpose: Broader ticker evaluation of frozen candidate; no automatic BUY or profit guarantee
paper_trade: Long only, enter target candle open and exit same candle close; idealized fills, no overlapping positions; not broker execution evidence
selection: No model/threshold selection or tuning using these test outcomes
production_promotion: disabled: independent prospective execution and adequate coverage still required
ranking: At each candle start choose at most one qualifying ticker by p_up minus p_down; deterministic ticker tie break; never rank by realized test profit
amendment_notice: Weekly recovery and deterministic signal ranking documented after coverage counts, before frozen-model scoring and paper-trade outcomes.
